meaning_en: A rule lacks the rate, affinity, or time constants (kcat·Km, Kd, half-life) needed to decide competition, duration, or termination.
Molar concentration, molecules per cell, compartment volume, or mass balance is absent, so starting amounts rest on defaults or infinite pools.
3D coordinates, residue numbering, stoichiometry, or membrane topology is unknown or borrowed from another molecule.
No regeneration or supply path, or its rate, so a reservoir depletes and the pathway stalls; a post-mortem named it limiting. Closes when a supply rule's rate and starting amount arrive.
Mediating steps of signal-to-metabolism or metabolism-to-gene regulation (receptor, STAT, mTORC1, chromatin) are lumped into one modulation rule, or its constants (K·n·fmax) are unknown.
The error bars of available observations cannot separate competing hypotheses, or no observation exists to judge against.
A required external ID (ChEBI, UniProt, …) could not be matched against the source, leaving only a stated reason in unmapped. Closes when a verified ID arrives.
A stored value disagrees with a newer source consensus (trend mismatch, grade demoted to legacy), or no new source exists to check the trend. The value is not deleted — why it diverged is the datum.
Molecule count per cell or compartment (dimension: count).
Molar concentration in mol/L.
Dimensionless fraction or ratio of a quantity (0–1).
Time at which a state or threshold is first reached (seconds).
Compartment or cell volume (litres).
A rate or affinity constant read out as the observable (kcat, Km, Kd, half-life).
Dimensionless ratio of two forms or targets (normalized band intensity, active fraction, fold-change).
Fraction of an ensemble whose amount is at or above a gating threshold (percent-positive, e.g. flow cytometry).
The readout is higher under the perturbation than in the control.
The readout is lower under the perturbation than in the control.
The readout is indistinguishable from the control within the declared equivalence margin.
The feature or species is present under the perturbation.
The feature or species is absent under the perturbation.
The readout rises monotonically across the readout series.
The readout falls monotonically across the readout series.
The readouts follow a declared rank order.

A conservation law exists for this quantity (mass/moiety balance), so it has an exact reference and a target error of 0. Carried as integer counts in the ledger; numerical error is eliminated by construction, not merely tracked.

No conservation law exists for this quantity, so there is no exact reference. Kept as float and its error is tracked as a budget (cannot be driven to 0). It is never mixed into the conserved ledger or the stored biology constants, and is never forced into fixed-point to feign exactness.
A count of molecules or moieties, conserved by mass balance (sum-in = sum-out) even as reactions create and consume it.
A per-unit-time change (1/s), such as a reaction rate — not a conserved substance.
A size-independent thermodynamic or environmental variable (ΔG, pH, temperature); it does not add up, so there is no balance to conserve.
Derived from conserved counts by a scaling or ratio (concentration = count × cinv; a fraction). Carries a float scale and has no conservation law of its own.
A derivative of the dynamics (Jacobian ∂rate/∂N) — a sensitivity, not a substance, so nothing is conserved.
An emergent quantity such as a first-passage event time; it has no reference answer, so its error is a budget only.
An empirically measured or set input (kcat, Km, Kd, half-life, a volume setting); it arrives with uncertainty and has no conservation law.
